title: Induction on the hybrid count for the PRF-to-PRG advantage bound
intent: Turn the PRF-to-PRG advantage bound into a telescoping sum of per-step PRF advantages by induction on the number of hybrid steps q, so that the only remaining content is two named per-step equivalences between adjacent hybrids.

parent.name: hyb_security_based_on_prf
parent.statement:
Theorem hyb_security_based_on_prf LA A q:
  ValidPackage LA
    [interface #val #[query]: 'unit → 'word × 'word ]
    A_export A ->
  fseparate LA EVAL_locs_tt ->
  fseparate LA EVAL_locs_ff ->
  fseparate LA GEN_HYB_locs ->
  AdvantageE (GEN_HYB_pkg 0) (GEN_HYB_pkg q) A <=
  \sum_(i < q) prf_epsilon (A ∘ GEN_HYB_EVAL_pkg i).

children.name: GEN_GEN_HYB_equiv
children.statement:
Lemma GEN_GEN_HYB_equiv i:
  GEN_HYB_pkg i ≈₀ GEN_HYB_EVAL_pkg i ∘ EVAL true.
children.closed_by: Qed (its own proof: apply eq_rel_perf_ind with the coupling count <= i -> k = None, then case: (eq_dec count i))
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: GEN_HYB_pkg i is perfectly indistinguishable (≈₀) from GEN_HYB_EVAL_pkg i composed with EVAL true, for every i.

children.name: GEN_GEN_HYB_EVAL_equiv
children.statement:
Lemma GEN_GEN_HYB_EVAL_equiv i:
  GEN_HYB_EVAL_pkg i ∘ EVAL false ≈₀ GEN_HYB_pkg i.+1.
children.closed_by: Qed (its own proof: apply eq_rel_perf_ind with the coupling count <= i -> T = emptym, then case: (eq_dec count i))
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: GEN_HYB_EVAL_pkg i composed with EVAL false is perfectly indistinguishable (≈₀) from GEN_HYB_pkg i.+1, for every i.

applicability.goal_shape: A `<=` inequality between an `AdvantageE` over the two end hybrids (`GEN_HYB_pkg 0`, `GEN_HYB_pkg q`) and a `\sum_(i < q)` of a per-step advantage; `q` is the induction variable, a natural number under the `\sum` that unfolds with `big_ord_recr`.
applicability.use_when: every adjacent pair of hybrids is related by an equivalence already stated as its own lemma (here `GEN_GEN_HYB_equiv` for the EVAL-true edge and `GEN_GEN_HYB_EVAL_equiv` for the EVAL-false edge), and the base case is the empty sum (`big_ord0`).
applicability.avoid_when: the per-step advantage is not uniform enough to be a single reusable equivalence, the step needs a different coupling each time, the base case is not the empty sum, or `q` is not a natural-number induction variable.

The step relies on `ssprove triangle` to insert the intermediate hybrids, then two rewrites `GEN_GEN_HYB_equiv` and `GEN_GEN_HYB_EVAL_equiv`, each with a validity side condition discharged by `ssprove_valid`. If either equivalence is missing or its package is not valid the rewrite fails.
